metadata.name: Technical observations and closure of findings
metadata.origen: Structure derived from an observations-and-closure example. Findings come from this project only.

secciones.seccion: Summary table: id, kind, severity, status, linked requirement.
Detail using the finding contract. Kind is confirmed defect, inferred risk, or pending clarification.
Closure note per finding: evidence path, residual risk, and the human decision still open.

prompt.regla: Do not copy observations from a calibration document. Do not mark a finding closed without a quality-pipeline SHA or an explicit human acceptance.
